measurement.outer_timer: Raw serialized inner-proof witness inputs through native BatchProof construction; includes GPU FRI and public proof-field reads. The immutable public program is prepared separately in each fresh process.
outside_outer_timer: Independent CPU preprocessing reconstruction and proof verification

limitations: Single-wallet verifier proof, not production wrapper/merge aggregation, worker-pool throughput or a transaction-per-hour estimate.
No paired baseline or CPU/OpenCL proving comparison is included. Small differences from the prior benchmark do not establish a performance improvement or regression.
Each sample uses fresh preparation. The tests qualify public preprocessing reuse after failure, but this benchmark does not time failed-attempt retries or a persistent-worker cache.
Focused ownership-path race checks passed; full-size recursive race instrumentation remains incomplete as recorded in the qualification.
Only the desktop RTX 5080 was measured. Larger domains and other GPUs require separate admission and qualification.
